result.instructions: Tools for Benchmark Email, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Benchmark Email data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run benchmark_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run benchmark_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run benchmark_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. benchmark_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: benchmark_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Benchmark Email account this token belongs to: client id, name, company, email, status, plan products, contact count and emails sent. GET /Client/ProfileDetails.

tools.name: benchmark_get_plan
tools.title: Get plan and usage
tools.description: The account's email plan, add-ons and contact usage (active, account and total contacts, percent used). GET /Client/Plan.

tools.name: benchmark_get_settings
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Default sender settings: from name and email, signature, footer, time zone, language and company address. The API token in the reply is removed. GET /Client/Setting.

tools.name: benchmark_list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List contact lists with id, name, description, contact count and dates. Use the ids with the contact tools. GET /Contact/.

search.description: Only lists whose name matches this text.

order_by.description: Sort column as the vendor documents it: date, count, email or schedule.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: benchmark_get_list
tools.title: Get contact list
tools.description: One contact list: name, description, active contact count and its custom field names (Field1Name ...). GET /Contact/{list_id}.

list_id.description: Contact list id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_get_list_fields
tools.title: Get contact list fields
tools.description: The column names of a contact list (email, firstname, lastname and the custom fields). GET /Contact/{list_id}/Fields.

list_id.description: Contact list id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_create_list
tools.title: Create contact list
tools.description: WRITE: create an empty contact list. POST /Contact/.

tools.name: benchmark_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List the saved segments (filtered subsets of lists) with id and name. GET /Contact/Segments.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: benchmark_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts in a list
tools.description: List the contacts of one list with email, name, dates and id. Filter by status (subscribed, unsubscribed, hard_bounced) or search a column. GET /Contact/{list_id}/ContactDetails.

list_id.description: Contact list id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

status.description: Only contacts with this status (subscribed = all except unsubscribed and hard bounced).

search_field.description: Column to search, e.g. email, firstname, lastname.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: benchmark_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact of a list with all its fields (Field1 ... Field24 hold the custom columns). GET /Contact/{list_id}/ContactDetails/{contact_id}.

list_id.description: Contact list id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

contact_id.description: Contact id (the ID of a list or search row) (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts by email
tools.description: Find an email address across all lists: one row per list it is on, with the list name, contact id and master-unsubscribe flag. GET /Contact/ContactDetails.

tools.name: benchmark_add_contact
tools.title: Add contact to a list
tools.description: WRITE: add one contact to a list (or update it if the email is already there, as the vendor decides). It does not send any email. Only add people who agreed to get email. POST /Contact/{list_id}/ContactDetails.

list_id.description: Contact list id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

custom_fields.description: Custom list columns by slot, e.g. {"Field1": "12 High St"}. Slot names come from benchmark_get_list (Field1Name ...).

permission.description: Set true only if the person has given email permission (EmailPerm 1).

tools.name: benchmark_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one contact in one list. Only the fields you pass are sent. PATCH /Contact/{list_id}/ContactDetails/{contact_id}.

list_id.description: Contact list id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

contact_id.description: Contact id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

custom_fields.description: Custom list columns by slot, e.g. {"Field1": "12 High St"}. Slot names come from benchmark_get_list (Field1Name ...).

tools.name: benchmark_unsubscribe_contact
tools.title: Unsubscribe contact
tools.description: WRITE: move a contact to the Do Not Contact (master unsubscribe) list, so no campaign reaches it again. The API has no undo for this. DELETE /Contact/{list_id}/MoveToDNC/{contact_id}.

list_id.description: Contact list id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

contact_id.description: Contact id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_list_emails
tools.title: List emails (campaigns)
tools.description: List email campaigns with id, name, subject, type, status, dates and target lists. GET /Emails/.

search.description: Only emails whose name matches this text.

status.description: Status filter as the vendor spells it (e.g. Draft, Scheduled, Sent).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: benchmark_get_email
tools.title: Get email (campaign)
tools.description: One email campaign: subject, sender, target and excluded lists, dates and settings. GET /Emails/{email_id}.

email_id.description: Email id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_list_email_reports
tools.title: List email report summaries
tools.description: Report summaries of sent emails: sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes and complaints per campaign. GET /Emails/Report.

search.description: Only emails whose name matches this text.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: benchmark_get_email_report
tools.title: Get email report
tools.description: The report summary of one email: recipients, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, forwards, complaints and rates. GET /Emails/{email_id}/Report.

email_id.description: Email id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_get_email_opens
tools.title: Get email opens
tools.description: Who opened an email: contact, email address, time and device. GET /Emails/{email_id}/Report/Opens.

email_id.description: Email id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: benchmark_get_email_clicks
tools.title: Get email clicks
tools.description: Who clicked a link in an email: contact, email address and time. GET /Emails/{email_id}/Report/Clicks.

email_id.description: Email id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_get_email_bounces
tools.title: Get email bounces
tools.description: Which addresses bounced for an email: contact, email address, time and bounce type. GET /Emails/{email_id}/Report/Bounces.

email_id.description: Email id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_get_email_unsubscribes
tools.title: Get email unsubscribes
tools.description: Who unsubscribed after an email: contact, email address, time and reason, with a count per reason. GET /Emails/{email_id}/Report/Unsubscribes.

email_id.description: Email id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_list_signup_forms
tools.title: List signup forms
tools.description: List signup forms with id, name, date and the lists they feed. GET /SignupForm/.

search.description: Only forms whose name matches this text.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: benchmark_get_signup_form
tools.title: Get signup form
tools.description: One signup form with its settings and target lists. GET /SignupForm/{form_id}.

form_id.description: Signup form id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: benchmark_get_signup_form_link
tools.title: Get signup form link
tools.description: The public link of a signup form. GET /SignupForm/{form_id}/Link.

form_id.description: Signup form id (digits only, as returned by the list tools).
